description: This file defines the AccessTokenRepository class implementing OAuth2 token management, including creation, persistence, revocation, and status checking of access tokens within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: AccessTokenRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 access token management including creation, persistence, revocation, and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the repository with an access token entity and bean manager.

methods.name: getNewToken
methods.description: Creates a new access token entity with specified client, scopes, and user identifier.

methods.name: persistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Persists a new access token to storage, associating it with a user and client, and handling grant types.

methods.name: revokeAccessToken
methods.description: Revokes an access token by marking it as deleted.

methods.name: isAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks if an access token has been revoked or expired.
